comments.author: @MikeyMadness92
comments.text: In kuldra fight, if you look closely when your doing skips you can see little invisible floating cubes and I think those are death cubes you need to avoid, can confirm kuldra skip harder, but doable as before

comments.author: @WPWArt
comments.text: On the last bit where the elementals are, you can still jump through the gap at the beginning and get off the map. They’ve added some rocks, but if you time it right, you can still do the original skip there to get to kuldras sanctum

comments.author: @haydenjones953
comments.text:
The vault guardian part- you can jump on the lower part of the pipe and windstep onto the highest part of the pipe (without having to turn the valve to activate the moving platforms)
As for the fire, you can siphon the fire anima without stepping on the centre bit by standing close to it (without having to wake up the vault guardians)
